recipes.name: Red Lentil & Vegetable Soup
recipes.seasonalNote: Red lentils need no soaking and cook fast, saving both energy and time.
steps: 1. Soften the onion and garlic in a little oil for 3 minutes.
2. Add carrots, tomatoes, and cumin; cook 2 minutes.
3. Add lentils and stock; simmer 20 minutes until soft.
4. Season, blend part of the soup if you like it thicker, and serve with lemon.

recipes.name: Chickpea Curry
recipes.seasonalNote: Chickpeas are a low-impact protein that store dried for months.
steps: 1. Soften onion, ginger, and garlic for 4 minutes.
2. Add tomatoes and spices; cook until thick, about 8 minutes.
3. Add chickpeas with a splash of water; simmer 15 minutes.
4. Scatter coriander and serve with rice or flatbread.

recipes.name: Vegetable Stir-Fry with Rice
recipes.seasonalNote: Uses whatever vegetables are in season and cooks in minutes on high heat.
steps: 1. Cook the rice and keep warm.
2. Heat the oil on high; add garlic and the firmest vegetables first.
3. Add remaining vegetables; toss for 4–5 minutes, keeping them crisp.
4. Add soy sauce and spring onions; serve over rice.

recipes.name: Spinach & Potato Curry
recipes.seasonalNote: Spinach and potatoes are hardy winter staples in many regions.
ingredients: 1 tsp mustard seeds or cumin seeds
steps: 1. Boil or steam potatoes until just tender; drain.
2. Soften onion with the seeds and garlic.
3. Add turmeric, chilli, and potatoes; cook 5 minutes.
4. Fold in spinach until wilted; season and serve.

recipes.name: Seasonal Fruit Bowl with Mint & Lime
recipes.seasonalNote: Built on whichever fruit is ripe and local right now — the recipe changes with the market.
ingredients: 2–3 ripe seasonal fruits (such as mango, melon, peach, or berries), cut into chunks
a handful of mint leaves, torn
steps: 1. Cut the fruit into bite-size pieces.
2. Toss gently with lime juice and salt.
3. Rest 5 minutes, scatter mint, and serve cool.

recipes.name: Bean & Vegetable Patties
recipes.seasonalNote: A good home for leftover cooked beans and vegetables.
steps: 1. Mash the beans roughly with a fork, leaving some texture.
2. Mix in carrot, onion, oats, and spices; rest 5 minutes.
3. Shape into 8 patties.
4. Pan-cook 4 minutes per side until crisp; serve in buns or with salad.

recipes.name: Tomato & Basil Pasta
recipes.seasonalNote: Best with ripe summer tomatoes, when they need little cooking.
steps: 1. Cook pasta in salted water; save a cup of the water.
2. Soften garlic in the oil for 1 minute.
3. Add tomatoes; cook 8 minutes until saucy.
4. Toss pasta through with a splash of its water, tear in basil, and season.

recipes.name: Overnight Oats with Seasonal Fruit
recipes.seasonalNote: No cooking at all — the fridge does the work overnight.
ingredients: 150 ml milk or plant alternative, or water
a handful of seasonal fruit, chopped
steps: 1. Stir oats, liquid, and yogurt in a jar or bowl.
2. Cover and refrigerate overnight (at least 6 hours).
3. Top with the fruit and sweetener in the morning and eat cold.
